craft_notes: Sthāyin: measurer fit to measures. Sanskrit-first: māyā-pramātṛ (MĀYĀ-MEASURER — kept); meya-jagat (MEASURED-WORLD — kept; pentads unenumerated per UNC). Rows: 3 (measurer/measures echo across the break), 1 (‘measures’ closes). Close: ‘fit to a world of measures’. Rupture: em-dash (made stated, then its fitness). Rejected: enumerating pentads — killed by UNC (NOTE holds standard); ‘surveyor’ — killed: measurer measures. Read aloud: MADE of THAT-tight-en-ing — the MĀ-yā-MEA-sur-er … FIT to A-world OF-mea-SURES.

lines: Made of that tightening — the māyā-measurer,
fit to a world of measures.

reads_against.argmap: What lies on the way down? → Descent inventoried: mind, knower, pentads, every school seated.
c1_essence: Mind tightened, knower measured, pentads stationed, schools seated on the descent.
